retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, minimalist layout featuring a single word in black, slightly distorted sans-serif typography centered on a vibrant, flat acid-green background.
triggerTerms: acid green background with black text
lime green square with centered text

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, square composition dominated by a saturated lime-green field, featuring a centered, lowercase black sans-serif word that exhibits slight vertical stretching and soft, low-resolution edge aliasing.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between black glyphs and neon green field
Centric alignment of text within a perfectly square frame
Balance between large negative space and compact typographic block
Intentional low-fidelity texture on letter edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Text is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 25% of the total width.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Static; the eye is immediately drawn to the center and remains there due to the lack of peripheral detail.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive, uniform green negative space surrounding the central text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Acid/Lime Green (Hex: #8ACE00) as the solid background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation background with zero-value foreground.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 't' has a standard crossbar and slight curve at the base

anatomy.corners: slightly rounded due to low resolution

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the basic skeleton and condensed feel.
Provides the clean, neutral sans-serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid, flat square of acid green (Hex #8ACE00) with no texture or lighting effects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a single word in the center using a black, lowercase, condensed sans-serif font. Apply a slight vertical stretch and a subtle low-resolution blur to the edges of the text.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat, vibrant lime green?
Is the text lowercase and black?
Is there a slight low-res/aliased quality to the text edges?

mustRedesign: Any logos or specific brand names
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no white borders around the square.
Confirm text is not crisp/vector-sharp but slightly soft-edged.
Verify the green is neon/acidic rather than forest or olive.
Check that the text is strictly lowercase.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid #8ACE00 background + Centered black lowercase condensed sans-serif + 1.1x vertical stretch + 1px Gaussian blur on text layer.
